lots.condition: Circulated copper, brown, typical album toning; folders with some edge wear. Key dates 1925 and 1930 absent. Individual grades not visible at this resolution.
lots.question_for_armitage: Can you confirm which slots are empty (is it only 1925 and 1930?), whether the 1946, 1932 and 1933 pennies are present, and whether any coins are loose or swapped into the wrong slots?
